notes:
v4.6.130 — AI model selection now reaches cloud bots; day P/L fix

🤖 Changing a bot's AI provider/model now SYNCS to the server automatically when you hit Save (it only saved locally before, so cloud bots kept using the default — Claude). After saving, RESTART the bot (⏹ then ▶) so it trades on the new model. Make sure that provider's API key is entered + synced in Tools.

🧹 Bots that don't use an LLM (algorithmic / ML bots) no longer show the AI MODEL selector.

🛠 Fixed: per-bot DAY P/L showed $0.00. Each bot's card now shows the same broker-authoritative daily figure as the headline (Alpaca last-close / IBKR ledger baseline) instead of a desktop-snapshot value that could read $0.

Update via the in-app banner.
